divergence: Canonical and relocation-strict objdiff measure 40.533333% (60 retail bytes versus 44 generated bytes). GC/1.3 schedules mulli before global-address formation, uses r6 rather than r7 for the saved return value, and folds the retail source-array and destination-base addi/add operations into indexed expressions; consequently the four matching named relocation targets/types/zero addends occur four bytes later. A distinct mutable byte-pointer/offset trial made all four relocation offsets exact and matched the first five retail operations, but generated 48 bytes and regressed to 38.6%, so it was reverted.
